missing: A tested, side-by-side comparison of current NAS models (Synology, UGREEN DH, QNAP, BeeStation) for a household of four iPhones and a Mac, with today's prices. It would set the full cost (enclosure, drives and an offsite backup) against the $9.99 a month for iCloud+ 2TB. It would also list exactly what the family loses: full iPhone device backups, Shared Photo Library, native Photos sync, Live Photo handling, Find My and Hide My Email.
why: This search is open. No major reviewer or authority answers it with testing. Gizmodo's page is about cloud services, not NAS boxes. Synology and Zima only cover their own products. The rest are affiliate roundups (one built around a one- or two-person household), a UGREEN-only review, a forum question with no answers shown, and Apple Scoop's guide, which admits it did no testing. A focused page could stand out by comparing NAS models for this family setup, adding up the full cost against iCloud+ 2TB, and listing what you lose.
